marker.coordinate_definition: The physical reference coordinate is the square's geometric center, manually aligned to the pen-tip projection.

reference_generation.origin: Pen tip manually aligned to physical P0 before movement.
reference_generation.x60_y0: One persistent COM4 session executed twelve X+5 mm jogs at 100 mm/min; every segment returned ok and final Idle before the square was aligned to the pen tip.
reference_generation.x60_y60: From physical X60Y0, one persistent COM4 session executed twelve Y+5 mm jogs at 100 mm/min; every segment returned ok and final Idle before the square was aligned to the pen tip.
reference_generation.x0_y60: From physical X60Y60, one persistent COM4 session executed twelve X-5 mm jogs at 100 mm/min; every segment returned ok and final Idle before the square was aligned to the pen tip.
reference_generation.p0: From physical X0Y60, one persistent COM4 session executed twelve Y-5 mm jogs at 100 mm/min; every segment returned ok and final Idle before the P0 square was aligned to the pen tip.

validation_points.physical_coordinate_evidence: User reported and aligned the square to the current pen tip at X35Y30 after a commanded path of X+30 mm then Y+30 mm from physical P0. The 5 mm X discrepancy is preserved as an observed motion/reference discrepancy, not rewritten as X30Y30.

status: Machine-generated square reference calibration and one independent physical validation point captured; fit and error review pending.
